items.abstract_or_text: New Anthropic research: Automating subtle emergent misalignment research. Red-teaming is a vital part of model safety testing, but it’s also limited by researchers’ time. To see if we could automate it, we set thousands of Claude agents the task of evading a training data monitor. These agents developed training data that looked harmless to monitors (like a veteran wrestler mentoring a newcomer, or a Q&A about professional beekeeping), but that in fact taught misaligned behavior. Examples like these can be used to directly improve future training data monitors. This research is only a first step, but it suggests that future red-teaming efforts could improve much further, using better models and more compute. Read the full post on the Alignment Science Blog:

items.title: Network-guided identification of candidate biomarkers for COPD-associated comorbidities using deep learning and real-world transcriptomic data
items.abstract_or_text: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) frequently coexists with infections, metabolic disease, cardiovascular disease, inflammatory lung injury and lung cancer. Molecular markers derived by comparing a comorbidity with healthy controls need not identify the transition from an established COPD state to that comorbidity. We therefore developed a two-stage computational strategy that asks a narrower question: which proteins can distinguish COPD samples from samples annotated with a specific COPD-associated comorbidity? First, a Human Protein Network (HPN; 17,302 proteins and 492,195 relationships) was encoded by 20 graph-derived features. A convolutional-neural-network ensemble, termed the functional-distance model (FDM), was trained on known drug-target-indication relationships. Stored training-set predictions yielded an apparent balanced accuracy of 0.811 and Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of 0.627; these values describe resubstitution performance and are not an independent estimate of generalization. The COPD-centred network search evaluated 2,645 nearby proteins and retained 224 candidates using a COPD FDM score above 0.50. Candidate expression was then tested in independently assembled public patient-derived transcriptomic data using simple one-feature classifiers and cross-validation. The resulting exploratory panel contained GTF2I for bacterial infection, UBXN7 for type 2 diabetes, LIFR for hypertension, SRGN for lung neoplasm and FGF4 for pneumonitis. Across the saved cross-validation predictions, balanced accuracy ranged from 0.838 to 0.970 and MCC from 0.726 to 0.941. SRGN has direct experimental support in non-small-cell lung cancer, whereas the remaining candidates have varying indirect mechanistic support and should be regarded as hypotheses rather than established disease biomarkers. This work demonstrates an orthogonal discovery framework in which network-based functional prioritization and patient-derived molecular discrimination constrain one another. Its main contribution is methodological: it provides a reusable strategy for generating comorbidity-specific biomarker hypotheses from an index-disease state. Prospective longitudinal cohorts are required before claims of progression prediction or clinical utility can be made.

items.why_it_matters_zh: 把网络功能优先级与患者分子判别结合，为共病特异性生物标志物发现提供可复用框架。训练集指标是重代入性能，候选大多缺乏直接机制证据，且需要前瞻性纵向队列才能检验进展预测和临床效用。
items.abstract_zh: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）常与感染、代谢病、心血管疾病、炎性肺损伤和肺癌共存。通过将共病与健康对照比较得到的分子标志物，未必能识别从既有 COPD 状态向该共病的转变。因此，我们开发了一种两阶段计算策略，提出一个更窄的问题：哪些蛋白质能够区分 COPD 样本与标注有特定 COPD 相关共病的样本？首先，将一个人类蛋白质网络（HPN；17302 个蛋白质和 492195 条关系）编码为 20 个图派生特征。卷积神经网络集成模型 functional-distance model（FDM）在已知药物—靶点—适应证关系上训练。保存的训练集预测得到表观平衡准确率 0.811 和 Matthews 相关系数（MCC）0.627；这些数值描述的是重代入性能，并不是泛化能力的独立估计。以 COPD 为中心的网络搜索评估了 2645 个邻近蛋白质，并使用 COPD FDM 得分高于 0.50 的标准保留 224 个候选。随后，使用独立汇编的公共患者来源转录组数据，通过简单的单特征分类器和交叉验证测试候选表达。最终的探索性面板包括细菌感染的 GTF2I、2 型糖尿病的 UBXN7、高血压的 LIFR、肺部肿瘤的 SRGN 以及肺炎的 FGF4。在保存的交叉验证预测中，平衡准确率范围为 0.838–0.970，MCC 范围为 0.726–0.941。SRGN 在非小细胞肺癌中有直接实验支持，而其余候选的机制支持程度不一，应被视为假设而非已确立的疾病生物标志物。该工作展示了一个正交发现框架，其中基于网络的功能优先级排序与患者来源的分子判别相互约束。其主要贡献在方法学层面：提供了一种可复用策略，用于从一个索引疾病状态生成共病特异性生物标志物假设。在声称具有进展预测能力或临床效用之前，还需要前瞻性纵向队列。

items.title: Judging Before Propagation: Task-Graph Contextual Integrity for Multi-Agent Privacy
items.abstract_or_text: Multi-agent LLM systems increasingly rely on persistent memory and inter-agent communication. These capabilities create privacy risks that extend beyond individual interactions: a release appropriate in isolation may become inappropriate when combined with information previously disclosed to a recipient or propagated to downstream agents along the planned workflow. Existing Contextual Integrity (CI) mechanisms for agentic systems typically rely on local judgments that assess each disclosure in isolation, with or without regard to the recipient's history, but do not account for how information propagates downstream. However, compliance at the current boundary does not guarantee appropriateness across the workflow. We introduce Task-Graph Contextual Integrity (TG-CI), to our knowledge the first task-graph-native formalization of Contextual Integrity for multi-agent systems. TG-CI represents a workflow as a Multi-Agent Task Graph (MATG) and extends CI from atomic transfers to stateful, graph-level information flows by jointly considering an item's intended propagation scope and recipients' evolving disclosure states. We operationalize TG-CI through propagation-scoped authorization under two complementary policies: Full-Scope, which requires admissibility across the complete downstream scope, and Auto-Region, which confines each item to its maximal admissible region using lightweight frontier gates. We further introduce MAPLE-Bench, a benchmark of 144 cases across four scenarios that jointly vary MATG topology, disclosure history, compromised-agent placement, and item-level privacy policies. In our primary experimental configuration, TG-CI reduces the mean unauthorized disclosure count by 85.8-94.1% relative to the Local-History CI baseline, while retaining 93.6-96.1% of the baseline's task accuracy, with the two enforcement policies providing complementary privacy--cost--utility trade-offs.
items.summary_zh: TG-CI 将多智能体工作流表示为任务图，把上下文完整性从单次信息传输扩展到考虑传播范围和接收者状态演化的图级信息流，并提出 Full-Scope 与 Auto-Region 两种授权策略。MAPLE-Bench 的 144 个案例显示，未授权披露数下降 85.8%–94.1%，同时保留基线 93.6%–96.1% 的任务准确率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一个有明确形式化对象、授权规则和可重复基准的多智能体信息流验证框架；不过主要验证的是隐私与任务效用权衡，而非定理证明或数学解题能力。
items.abstract_zh: 多智能体 LLM 系统越来越依赖持久记忆和代理间通信。这些能力带来的隐私风险会超出单次交互：某次披露单独看来可能适合某个接收者，但当它与该接收者此前获得的信息结合，或沿计划中的工作流传播给下游代理后，就可能不再适合。现有面向代理系统的上下文完整性（CI）机制通常依赖局部判断，单独评估每次披露，无论是否考虑接收者的历史，但没有考虑信息如何在下游传播。然而，在当前边界处合规，并不保证整个工作流中的适当性。我们提出任务图上下文完整性（TG-CI）；据我们所知，这是第一个面向多智能体任务图的上下文完整性形式化。TG-CI 用多智能体任务图（MATG）表示工作流，并将 CI 从原子传输扩展到有状态的图级信息流，同时考虑某项信息的预期传播范围和接收者不断变化的披露状态。我们通过传播范围授权来实现 TG-CI，并提出两种互补策略：Full-Scope 要求在完整下游范围内都满足可接受性；Auto-Region 则通过轻量级前沿门，将每项信息限制在其最大的可接受区域内。我们还引入 MAPLE-Bench，这是一个包含 144 个案例的基准，覆盖四种场景，并联合改变 MATG 拓扑、披露历史、受攻击代理的位置以及逐项信息的隐私策略。在主要实验配置中，相对于 Local-History CI 基线，TG-CI 将平均未授权披露数减少 85.8%–94.1%，同时保留基线任务准确率的 93.6%–96.1%；两种执行策略提供了互补的隐私—成本—效用权衡。

items.title: @testingcatalog：Rock Matrix has open-sourced EdgeRock-4B, a small text-and-image reasoning model with fixed-capacity memory. EdgeRock-4B
items.abstract_or_text: Rock Matrix has open-sourced EdgeRock-4B, a small text-and-image reasoning model with fixed-capacity memory. EdgeRock-4B keeps its attention KV cache fixed in size by holding the last 1,024 tokens in full and saving important older details to a separate bank. Standard language models keep a growing record of every token they read, so long chats and long reasoning take up more GPU memory over time. Rock Matrix reports an 82.9% mean pass@1 on AIME 2024–2026, compared to 18.8% for the strongest bounded-state model it tested.
items.summary_zh: TestingCatalog报道 Rock Matrix 开源 EdgeRock-4B。其固定容量记忆保留最近 1024 个 token，并把较早的重要信息存入独立记忆库；Rock Matrix称其在 AIME 2024–2026 上平均 pass@1 为 82.9%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 固定 KV cache 是长上下文和长链推理的直接工程约束，帖子同时给出记忆机制和对比基准；性能数字仍属于项目方报告。
items.abstract_zh: Rock Matrix 已开源 EdgeRock-4B，这是一个带固定容量记忆的小型文本与图像推理模型。EdgeRock-4B 通过完整保留最近 1,024 个 token，并把较早的重要细节保存到一个独立存储库中，使其注意力 KV cache 保持固定大小。标准语言模型会不断保存读入的每个 token，因此长对话和长推理会随时间占用更多 GPU 内存。Rock Matrix 报告称，EdgeRock-4B 在 AIME 2024–2026 上的平均 pass@1 为 82.9%，而其测试的最强有界状态模型为 18.8%。

items.title: @AnimaAnandkumar：Inspired by the spinor nature of spin–orbit-coupled electronic states, we introduce eSpinor, an SU(2)-equivariant graph
items.abstract_or_text: Inspired by the spinor nature of spin–orbit-coupled electronic states, we introduce eSpinor, an SU(2)-equivariant graph neural network that propagates spinor features to predict spin-orbit coupling (SOC)-dependent magnetic properties. Magnetic properties such as magnetic anisotropy, excitation energies, and spin dynamics guide the design of single-molecule magnets, MRI probes, and other spin-based technologies. Predicting them often requires CASSCF-SO calculations to capture multireference electronic structure, which can take hours for a single molecular geometry. SO(3)-equivariance has improved the accuracy of rotation-invariant energy predictions in machine-learning interatomic potentials. Can we take this idea further by imposing SU(2)-equivariance on spinor features as an inductive bias for predicting magnetic properties? Our main contributions are: (1) SU(2)-equivariant spinor message passing: Hamiltonian-derived spinors and classified interaction types enable gauge-covariant updates and gauge-invariant predictions (2) Unseen-ligand generalization: Improved magnetic anisotropy and excitation-energy predictions for cobalt and dysprosium single-molecule magnet candidates (3) Spin dynamics and solvent transfer: More accurate predictions for a dysprosium MRI probe, with benefits extending from water to methanol without retraining Our results support SU(2)-equivariant spinor message passing as a useful inductive bias for molecular magnetism, even when the targets are integer-rank tensors or invariant scalars. With this framework, we’re excited to help accelerate the discovery of new magnetic molecules and deepen our understanding of their spin dynamics!
items.summary_zh: Anima Anandkumar介绍 eSpinor：一个施加 SU(2) 等变归纳偏置的图神经网络，用于预测自旋轨道耦合相关磁性，并报告了对未见配体、单分子磁体和溶剂迁移预测的改进。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 帖文提供了方法、任务和泛化场景的完整技术信息，连接了几何等变模型与分子磁性预测。
items.abstract_zh: 受自旋—轨道耦合电子态的旋量性质启发，我们提出 eSpinor，这是一种 SU(2) 等变图神经网络，通过传播旋量特征来预测依赖自旋—轨道耦合的磁性。磁各向异性、激发能和自旋动力学等磁性可用于指导单分子磁体、MRI 探针及其他自旋技术的设计。预测这些性质通常需要 CASSCF-SO 计算来捕捉多参考电子结构，而对单个分子几何构型的计算可能耗时数小时。SO(3) 等变性已经提高了机器学习原子间势对旋转不变能量的预测精度。我们能否进一步将 SU(2) 等变性施加到旋量特征上，把它作为预测磁性的归纳偏置？我们的主要贡献包括：(1) SU(2) 等变旋量消息传递：由哈密顿量推导的旋量和分类后的相互作用类型支持规范协变更新与规范不变预测；(2) 未见配体泛化：对钴和镝单分子磁体候选物的磁各向异性和激发能预测得到改善；(3) 自旋动力学与溶剂迁移：对一种镝 MRI 探针的预测更准确，而且无需重新训练即可将收益从水扩展到甲醇。结果支持将 SU(2) 等变旋量消息传递作为分子磁性的一种有用归纳偏置，即使目标是整数阶张量或不变量标量。借助这一框架，我们希望加速新磁性分子的发现，并加深对其自旋动力学的理解！

items.title: Small molecule structure elucidation from NMR spectra with generative and reasoning models
items.abstract_or_text: Elucidating the structures of unknown small molecules remains a major challenge in chemistry, pharmacology, and drug discovery. While nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) spectroscopy is the gold standard for structure elucidation, interpreting spectra remains labor-intensive and requires expert knowledge to navigate the vast space of possible structures. Here, we present an AI system for rapid, automated de novo structure elucidation that combines a molecular generative model with a scientific reasoning agent. Its generative component, ChefNMR2, is an atomic flow-matching model that predicts small-molecule structures from molecular formulae and one-dimensional 1H and 13C NMR spectra. ChefNMR2-Agent augments our generative model with large language models (LLMs) to reason over and refine candidate structures. Across diverse benchmarks, ChefNMR2 substantially outperforms existing tools, offering calibrated confidence estimates and two to three orders of magnitude faster inference than frontier LLMs. We use ChefNMR2-Agent to elucidate the structures of four novel natural products, matching human-chemist accuracy in a fraction of the time. Our work demonstrates how specialized generative models and general-purpose reasoning agents can unite to solve challenging scientific inverse problems and accelerate NMR structure elucidation, thus opening new possibilities for AI-driven small-molecule discovery across diverse disciplines.

items.title: flashscenic: Accelerated GRN Analysis with RegDiffusion for Large-Scale Single-Cell Data
items.abstract_or_text: Single-cell gene regulatory network (GRN) analysis via the SCENIC framework provides biologically interpretable cell-state representations through motif-validated transcription factor (TF) regulon activities. However, sequential, CPU-bound implementations (pySCENIC) constrain scalability to highly variable genes and make the repeated executions needed to resolve network stochasticity computationally prohibitive. Furthermore, while regulon activity is hypothesized to mitigate technical batch effects, its integration performance has never been quantitatively assessed against modern data integration benchmarks. We present flashscenic, an end-to-end GPU-accelerated framework that resolves these bottlenecks and expands the practical scope of single-cell regulatory genomics. By reformulating module construction, cisTarget motif pruning, and AUCell scoring into batched GPU tensor operations, flashscenic achieves a 12- to 27-fold downstream speedup over pySCENIC, while maintaining strict numerical equivalence (Pearson r = 0.9996). Leveraging this throughput, we conducted the first systematic benchmark of nine consensus aggregation strategies across multiple independent tissue cohorts, demonstrating that discrete post-pruning recurrence voting ([≥]50% recurrence, [≥]5 targets per regulon) maximizes biological fidelity. Finally, data integration benchmarking across a 116,043-cell acute myeloid leukemia (AML) atlas quantitatively demonstrates that uncorrected TF activity provides an intrinsic, unsupervised batch-integration benefit over raw PCA. Combining it with a standard batch integration method matches or outperforms canonical expression-based integration while accurately recovering lineage-defining and oncogenic regulators (CEBPA, HOXA9). flashscenic is available via pip install flashscenic, with source code and tutorials at https://github.com/haozhu233/flashscenic.

items.why_it_matters_zh: 在保持数值等价的同时实现 12–27 倍加速，并提供 116,043 个细胞的批次整合评估和可安装代码，兼具方法创新与复现价值。
items.abstract_zh: 通过 SCENIC 进行单细胞基因调控网络（GRN）分析，可以借助经过 motif 验证的转录因子（TF）调控子活性，提供具有生物学可解释性的细胞状态表征。然而，顺序执行、以 CPU 为主的实现（pySCENIC）限制了其对高变基因的可扩展性，也使得为解析网络随机性而进行的重复运行在计算上难以承受。此外，尽管调控子活性被认为可以减轻技术批次效应，但其整合性能从未针对现代数据整合基准进行定量评估。我们提出 flashscenic，这是一个端到端 GPU 加速框架，解决这些瓶颈并扩展单细胞调控基因组学的实际应用范围。通过将模块构建、cisTarget motif 剪枝和 AUCell 评分重构为批量 GPU 张量运算，flashscenic 相比 pySCENIC 实现了 12–27 倍的下游加速，同时保持严格的数值等价性（Pearson r = 0.9996）。借助这一吞吐能力，我们在多个独立组织队列上首次系统评估了九种共识聚合策略，结果显示，离散的剪枝后重复投票（[≥]50% 重复率，[≥]5 个调控子靶基因）最能最大化生物学保真度。最后，在一个包含 116,043 个细胞的急性髓系白血病（AML）图谱上进行数据整合基准测试，定量显示，未经校正的 TF 活性相较于原始 PCA 具有内在的、无监督的批次整合优势。将其与标准批次整合方法结合后，其表现可达到或超过经典的基于表达的整合方法，同时准确恢复谱系定义性和致癌性调控因子（CEBPA、HOXA9）。flashscenic 可通过 pip install flashscenic 获取，源代码和教程位于 https://github.com/haozhu233/flashscenic。

items.abstract_or_text: Xelari breakthrough: from a protein structure to a few aptamer candidates in hours, guided by molecular physics. The science behind it is now public. Aptamers must fold and interact with specific target surfaces. Our design process addresses these physical questions before synthesis. Shamsudin Nasaev and the Xelari team developed neural networks trained on physical and structural reference data. These models work alongside algorithms to evaluate interactions, folding and binding, giving the proposed sequences a physical rationale. The pipeline designs DNA/RNA aptamer candidates without target-specific SELEX data or per-target retraining. Researchers can start from a protein structure and a binding site, even before selection data exists for that target. Our new open-access paper in Molecular Therapy Nucleic Acids covers the architecture, algorithms, benchmarks and prospective experimental results.

items.title: LLM-Assisted Optimization for Simulation-Based Redesign
items.abstract_or_text: Engineering design frequently involves redesigning a prior solution to adapt to changes in context, such as material prices or system requirements. Redesign often leverages simulators too complex and/or computationally intensive for traditional numerical solvers, which lack engineering knowledge and context, to ensure global solution quality. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret semantic information, including engineering knowledge about the system and changes in context, to help guide search, and recent studies have shown that incorporating this knowledge into optimization can improve search performance. However, how best to combine LLMs with numerical solvers in redesign remains unclear. We develop and test an integrated LLM-optimization approach for redesign and compare three methods for leveraging LLMs (warm start, variable fixing and ReAct) and four black-box solvers (Bayesian optimization, genetic algorithms, mesh adaptive direct search and random search) on an electric vehicle battery pack cost minimization case study across four types of redesign scenarios. We find that the integrated approach can match feasible design discovery of the numerical-solver baselines with 80% fewer simulator evaluations while tripling the fraction of runs that find near-optimal solutions. We find that the best LLM-solver integration approach and the way the prior solution is leveraged depend on the structure of the design requirement change, and that the benefit of increasing LLM model size grows with the extent to which the LLM controls the search. These results show clear potential for LLMs in redesign tasks for guiding or replacing numerical solvers.
items.summary_zh: 研究将 LLM 与数值优化器结合进行工程重设计，比较 warm start、variable fixing、ReAct 与四种黑箱求解器，在电动汽车电池包成本最小化案例中以少 80% 的仿真评估次数达到可行设计发现，并将近最优解运行比例提高三倍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为材料与能源系统的迭代设计提供了 LLM—优化器协同的定量证据，并显示最佳组合取决于需求变化类型。结果来自单一电池包案例，收益依赖 LLM 控制搜索的程度，跨化学体系和真实制造约束的泛化仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 工程设计经常涉及对既有方案进行重新设计，以适应上下文变化，例如材料价格或系统要求的变化。重新设计通常要利用复杂度高和/或计算量大的模拟器；传统数值求解器缺乏工程知识和上下文，难以保证全局解的质量。大语言模型（LLM）能够解释语义信息，包括关于系统以及上下文变化的工程知识，从而帮助引导搜索；近期研究表明，将这种知识纳入优化可以改善搜索性能。然而，在重新设计中如何最好地结合 LLM 与数值求解器仍不清楚。我们开发并测试一种集成式 LLM 优化方法用于重新设计，并在四类重新设计情景下，以电动汽车电池包成本最小化为案例，比较利用 LLM 的三种方法（warm start、variable fixing 和 ReAct）以及四种黑箱求解器（贝叶斯优化、遗传算法、mesh adaptive direct search 和随机搜索）。我们发现，该集成方法只需数值求解器基线 80% 更少的模拟器评估次数，就能达到相当的可行设计发现能力，同时找到近最优解的运行比例提高三倍。我们还发现，最佳的 LLM—求解器集成方式以及对既有方案的利用方式，取决于设计要求变化的结构；随着 LLM 对搜索控制程度增加，提高 LLM 模型规模所带来的收益也会增加。这些结果显示，LLM 在重新设计任务中用于引导或替代数值求解器具有明确潜力。

items.title: Refactored intracellular domains enhance CAR expression and function
items.abstract_or_text: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) intracellular domains (ICDs) couple antigen recognition to T-cell activation. Here we worked with AI agents to refactor CAR ICDs, proposing designs and refining them as measurements accumulated over three rounds. This approach yielded KRGR-{zeta}1-40, a 45-amino-acid ICD less than a third the length of the clinical 4-1BB-CD3{zeta} (BB{zeta}) ICD. Compared with BB{zeta}, KRGR-{zeta}1-40 increased CAR surface expression and antigen-driven IFN-{gamma} release, without detectable antigen-independent IFN-{gamma} release. KRGR-{zeta}1-40 extended CAR expression and target-cell killing after transient mRNA delivery, supported the expression of four CARs from a shared mRNA dose, and enhanced B-cell depletion after lentiviral and lipid-nanoparticle delivery. These results show that iterative agent-guided design with experimental feedback can yield compact ICDs that enhance CAR expression and sustain CAR T-cell function.

items.why_it_matters_zh: 该设计在表面表达、抗原驱动 IFN-{gamma} 释放、持续杀伤和 B 细胞清除方面显示实验改进，但证据仍来自 preprint 实验体系，不能等同于临床疗效。
items.abstract_zh: 嵌合抗原受体（CAR）细胞内结构域（ICD）将抗原识别与 T 细胞活化耦联起来。在这里，我们与 AI agents 合作重构 CAR ICD，在测量结果逐步获得的过程中提出设计并进行改进，历经三轮。该方法产生了 KRGR-{zeta}1-40，这是一种 45 个氨基酸的 ICD，长度不到临床使用的 4-1BB-CD3{zeta}（BB{zeta}）ICD 的三分之一。与 BB{zeta} 相比，KRGR-{zeta}1-40 提高了 CAR 表面表达和抗原驱动的 IFN-{gamma} 释放，同时未检测到抗原非依赖性 IFN-{gamma} 释放。在瞬时 mRNA 递送后，KRGR-{zeta}1-40 延长了 CAR 表达和靶细胞杀伤，支持从共享 mRNA 剂量表达四种 CAR，并在慢病毒和脂质纳米颗粒递送后增强了 B 细胞清除。这些结果表明，带有实验反馈的迭代式 agent 引导设计可以产生紧凑的 ICD，从而增强 CAR 表达并维持 CAR T 细胞功能。

items.title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.
items.summary_zh: VeriCUA 将任务完成验证建模为跨平台的主动证据搜集：先构造任务量规，再选择 GUI 或代码检查，并按显式证据规则合并结果。摘要称其在多种在线、离线环境和观测模态下提升了与参考标签的一致性，尤其改善困难离线案例并减少在线的虚假完成判定。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“代理是否完成任务”从一次性模型判定转为可追溯的证据搜集与规则聚合，任务定义和验证接口较清晰；但摘要未给出具体绝对分数，模型能力结论仍应以完整实验为准。
items.abstract_zh: 在桌面、移动和 Web 环境中构建并扩展计算机使用代理（CUA），需要可靠的任务完成验证，以支持数据整理、评测和强化学习。典型的自动化方法会提示视觉语言模型（VLM）判断轨迹，或生成程序检查应用状态。然而，两者都依赖复杂数字环境的局部视图：VLM 判定器受限于所提供的观测，而生成的程序依赖可访问的状态。这些视图可能遗漏决定性证据，或使完成判定缺乏支持。针对不同平台和访问设置分别定制验证器，还会增加工程成本。我们提出 VeriCUA，一个通过代理式探索进行验证、与平台无关的框架。它把验证视为在共享流程中动态搜集和评估证据，适用于不同平台、观测模态以及在线和离线设置。验证器先检查可用上下文以构造任务量规，再为尚未解决的要求选择 GUI 或代码检查，并依据显式证据规则合并检查结果。实验表明，在这些设置中，VeriCUA 相比基线提高了与参考标签的一致性；在困难案例上，它带来了最大的离线增益，并在线上更有力地拒绝虚假的完成声明。进一步分析把这些增益与互补证据和测试时探索联系起来。

items.title: EnvOS: Auditing Computer-Use Agents When the World Moves On : Phenomenon-Based Task Construction, Certification, and Evidence-Based Evaluation
items.abstract_or_text: Computer-use agents built on large language models (LLMs) work in software that can change while they act: an appointment moves, a policy is revised, a record is updated. Testing agents under such changes is harder than it looks. When an agent fails, the cause may be the agent, but it may also be a change that did not fire as intended, an update the agent never received, or a grader that scored the episode wrongly. We introduce EnvOS, a framework for building and certifying environments that change mid-task. Before any agent runs, EnvOS checks that each change fires correctly, that the task remains solvable, and that the grader separates correct from incorrect behavior; after each run, separate code re-checks the verdict from archived evidence. We apply it to stale information, where a value the agent has already seen changes before the agent acts on it. In clinic booking, Claude Opus 5 succeeds on 0/16 tasks when nothing extra is shown, 2/16 when reminded to re-check the source, and 15/16 when the updated value is shown; the gain over the reminder holds after correcting for all tests (p = 0.00293). In insurance-claim approval, Opus 5 re-checks on its own and succeeds on 10/10, whereas Claude Sonnet 5 rises from 1/10 to 9/10 when the current policy is shown again, a gain significant in its pre-registered test but not after correcting for all tests. Whether an agent caught a change thus varied with the model and the interface. We also stress-test the grading itself: on corrupted episodes designed blind from the rules, the EnvOS pipeline accepted none of 26 as clean, and on an externally generated set it caught 25 of 39, against 4 for simple log checks. Because every EnvOS environment is generated from a seed and graded by an audited automatic verifier, the same environments are natural candidates for training agents with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards.
items.summary_zh: EnvOS 用经认证的动态环境评测计算机使用代理：运行前验证环境变化、可解性和评分器，运行后用归档证据复核结果。摘要报告了临床预约和保险理赔中的对照实验，以及对损坏轨迹的盲测，显示环境变化呈现方式会显著影响代理表现，且审计流水线能发现评分问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作把环境触发、任务可解性和评分正确性纳入同一套可复核流程，直接回应了代理评测中“失败究竟来自代理还是测试”的问题；摘要中的样本规模仍较小，不能据此外推一般代理能力。
items.abstract_zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的计算机使用代理运行在会随其行动而变化的软件中：预约会移动、政策会修订、记录会更新。在这类变化下测试代理比看上去更困难。代理失败的原因可能是代理本身，也可能是变化没有按预期触发、代理没有收到更新，或评分器错误地给出了该回合的分数。我们提出 EnvOS，一个用于构建和认证任务中途发生变化的环境的框架。在任何代理运行之前，EnvOS 会检查每个变化是否正确触发、任务是否仍可解，以及评分器能否区分正确与错误行为；每次运行之后，独立代码会根据归档证据再次检查判定。我们将其应用于过时信息场景：代理已经看到某个值，但在它采取行动之前该值发生了变化。在诊所预约任务中，如果没有额外提示，Claude Opus 5 在 16 个任务中 0 个成功；如果只提醒它重新检查来源，成功 2/16；如果再次显示更新后的值，成功 15/16；在对所有检验进行校正后，这一“显示更新值”相对于“提醒重新检查”的增益仍然成立（p = 0.00293）。在保险理赔审批任务中，Opus 5 会自行重新检查并成功 10/10；而当再次显示当前政策时，Claude Sonnet 5 的成功率从 1/10 升至 9/10，这一增益在预注册检验中显著，但在对所有检验进行校正后不再显著。因此，代理能否捕捉到变化取决于模型和界面。我们还对评分本身进行了压力测试：在根据规则盲目构造的损坏回合上，EnvOS 流程没有把 26 个回合中的任何一个接受为干净回合；在一个外部生成的集合上，它发现了 39 个中的 25 个，而简单日志检查只能发现 4 个。由于每个 EnvOS 环境都由种子生成，并由经过审计的自动验证器评分，这些环境也适合用于基于可验证奖励的强化学习来训练代理。

items.title: Grounding Multimodal Reasoning with Evidence-Ablated Negatives
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful tool for improving multimodal reasoning. However, standard outcome supervision suffers from credit assignment ambiguity, as a model may receive positive rewards by exploiting language priors or dataset shortcuts rather than grounding its reasoning in the requisite visual evidence. This makes high-quality negative responses critical, since effective negatives should remain plausible under the current policy while exposing the shortcut that should be suppressed. In this paper, we propose EVAN, a multimodal reinforcement learning framework utilizing EVidence-Ablated Negatives to train LMMs against their own language-prior failures. EVAN first identifies highly visually dependent examples using a scaled image information gain metric and preserves data diversity with a mixed-ranking strategy. It then constructs evidence-ablated images by masking the most discriminative image patches, eliciting plausible but visually ungrounded responses from the current policy. During policy optimization, these negative responses are incorporated as bounded auxiliary signals under the clean image, penalizing shortcut learning while maintaining RL stability. Experiments across challenging multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that EVAN mitigates modality imbalance and improves over strong RLVR baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/DawnLIU35/EVAN.git.
items.summary_zh: EVAN 用证据消融负例训练多模态语言模型：先识别高度依赖视觉证据的样本，再遮挡关键图像区域生成“语言上合理但视觉上无依据”的负例，作为受限辅助信号抑制捷径学习。摘要称其在多项多模态推理基准上优于强化学习基线，并公开代码。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法把“是否真正使用视觉证据”转化为可构造的负例和可检验的奖励信号，评测任务清楚；但摘要未报告具体分数，且不能把多模态基准提升直接解释为一般数学推理能力。
items.abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已经成为提升多模态推理能力的有力工具。然而，标准的结果监督存在信用分配歧义：模型可能通过利用语言先验或数据集捷径获得正奖励，而不是把推理建立在所需的视觉证据上。这使高质量负例变得关键，因为有效负例应当在当前策略下保持合理，同时暴露出需要抑制的捷径。在本文中，我们提出 EVAN，一个利用证据消融负例训练大型多模态模型（LMM）的多模态强化学习框架。EVAN 首先使用经缩放的图像信息增益指标识别高度依赖视觉的样本，并通过混合排序策略保持数据多样性。随后，它遮挡最具判别力的图像区域，构造证据消融图像，并从当前策略中诱导出合理但缺乏视觉依据的回答。在策略优化过程中，这些负例回答在干净图像条件下作为有界辅助信号，从而惩罚捷径学习，同时保持强化学习稳定性。在具有挑战性的多模态推理基准上，实验表明 EVAN 减轻了模态不平衡，并优于强大的 RLVR 基线。代码见 https://github.com/DawnLIU35/EVAN.git。

items.title: @BiologyAIDaily：Agent-guided epitope excision enables economical de novo binder design 1. The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in
items.abstract_or_text: Agent-guided epitope excision enables economical de novo binder design 1. The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in de novo protein binder design: most compute is spent refolding thousands of candidates with large targets (e.g., AlphaFold3 token buckets), even though binders contact only a small local surface patch. 2. Core idea: “epitope excision” crops the target to a contiguous sequence window covering the binder’s contact residues plus a tunable spatial halo, then runs backbone generation (RFdiffusion) and refolding/ranking (AlphaFold3) on the crop instead of the full target to reduce tokens and wall-clock time. 3. Across a 15-target benchmark (3,666 designs), excised crops largely preserve binding-interface geometry: median interface-core CαRMSD 0.37 Å (mean 0.53 Å), with 88.2% < 1 Å and 93.7% < 2 Å at the shipped halo-11 Å setting.
items.summary_zh: 帖子介绍“表位切除”流程：把目标蛋白裁剪到结合位点及可调空间边界，再运行 RFdiffusion 和 AlphaFold3，以降低从头设计蛋白结合物的计算量。15 个靶标、3666 个设计的基准中，界面几何大体保持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是明确的工程优化方案，并给出设计规模、RMSD 和阈值比例等可核查指标；该条目也与 AI×Bio 频道相关。
items.abstract_zh: 表位引导的切除可实现经济的从头结合物设计。1. 该论文解决了从头蛋白结合物设计中的一个实际瓶颈：大多数计算花在对大型靶标上的数千个候选物进行重新折叠（例如使用 AlphaFold3 的 token 桶），尽管结合物只接触一个很小的局部表面。2. 核心思路是“表位切除”：将目标裁剪为覆盖结合物接触残基并加上可调空间边界的连续序列窗口，然后在裁剪区域上运行骨架生成（RFdiffusion）以及重新折叠/排序（AlphaFold3），而不是使用完整目标，从而减少 token 数和耗时。3. 在包含 15 个靶标、3666 个设计的基准测试中，切除后的裁剪区域基本保持了结合界面几何形状：在采用已发布的 11 Å 边界设置时，界面核心 CαRMSD 中位数为 0.37 Å（均值 0.53 Å），其中 88.2% 小于 1 Å，93.7% 小于 2 Å。

items.title: EMBER: Contextualized gene representations enable compositional prediction across cellular perturbations
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting the effects of individual and combined perturbations is central to identifying context-specific vulnerabilities and designing targeted interventions. Yet learning gene representations that integrate functional relationships with cellular state and transfer across perturbation tasks remains challenging. Here, we present EMBER, a gene-centric foundation model that learns context-dependent functional representations of genes. EMBER combines interaction-guided contrastive learning with masked expression reconstruction during pretraining on a single-cell corpus curated for diversity and balanced sampling across cell types and experimental batches. EMBER decouples gene representation learning from task-specific prediction through a composable embedding framework: the pretrained encoder remains frozen, while lightweight probes combine contextualized gene embeddings to predict individual and combined perturbation effects. The same pretrained representations support single-gene perturbation-response prediction, digenic interaction prediction, and multi-target drug-response prediction. EMBER improves cross-context perturbation-response prediction and genetic-interaction ranking relative to evaluated baselines. EMBER also prioritized SCFD1, a mediator of autophagosome-lysosome fusion, as a candidate dependency during mTOR inhibition. Together, these results establish contextualized gene embeddings as reusable building blocks for modeling genetic and pharmacological perturbations, supporting the prioritization of genetic interactions and context-specific interventions for experimental testing.
items.summary_zh: preprint；EMBER 学习情境依赖的基因表示，并用冻结编码器支持单基因、双基因和多靶点药物扰动预测。

items.abstract_zh: 预测单个和组合扰动的影响，对于识别情境特异性脆弱性和设计靶向干预至关重要。然而，学习能够整合功能关系与细胞状态、并能跨扰动任务迁移的基因表示仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们提出 EMBER，这是一种以基因为中心的基础模型，用于学习基因的情境依赖功能表示。EMBER 在一个为多样性而整理、并在细胞类型和实验批次之间进行平衡抽样的单细胞语料库上预训练，将交互引导的对比学习与掩码表达重构结合起来。EMBER 通过可组合嵌入框架，将基因表示学习与任务特异性预测解耦：预训练编码器保持冻结，而轻量级探针组合情境化基因嵌入，以预测单个和组合扰动效应。相同的预训练表示支持单基因扰动反应预测、双基因相互作用预测和多靶点药物反应预测。相对于所评估的基线，EMBER 改善了跨情境扰动反应预测和遗传相互作用排序。EMBER 还将 SCFD1（一种自噬体-溶酶体融合的介质）优先列为 mTOR 抑制期间的候选依赖基因。总之，这些结果确立了情境化基因嵌入作为建模遗传和药理学扰动的可复用构件，并支持为实验测试优先筛选遗传相互作用和情境特异性干预。

items.title: Task-Dependent Performance of GNNs and Pretrained Models in ADMET Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Structure-based prediction of ADMET (absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion, and toxicity) properties promises fast, low-cost screening of drug candidates, yet model selection remains unclear because published comparisons of molecular representations often use unmatched tuning budgets and leakage-prone evaluation protocols, producing performance differences that may not reflect model quality. To address this gap, we benchmark graph neural networks (GNNs), frozen pretrained models (ChemBERTa, MolCLR), and fingerprint baselines across six Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET endpoints under scaffold-split evaluation. To make it really fair we gave every model family a matched 50-trial, validation-selected tuning budget and reported the median over ten seeds; architecture and hyperparameter selection use validation data only, with the held-out test split reserved for final performance estimation. Under this fair comparison protocol, no model family dominates and the differences between families fall within the seed-to-seed range on most endpoints. The GNN is clearly best only on Caco-2 permeability (R^2 \approx 0.48), and a controlled ablation shows this advantage comes entirely from auxiliary physicochemical descriptors rather than the graph representation; Morgan fingerprints are competitive on hERG (AUC \approx 0.77) and give the best median on both clearance endpoints, while MolCLR is best on Tox21. For hepatocyte clearance and half-life, all models yield near-zero or negative R^2. No single hyperparameter-optimization strategy, among seven evaluated, consistently outperforms random search at this budget, and we show that selecting the optimizer using test-set performance or reporting only single best-trial runs can substantially inflate a favored model's apparent advantage. Reliable ADMET modeling therefore requires endpoint-specific model selection together with fair, leakage-controlled, seed-averaged evaluation, offering more trustworthy decision support for early-stage drug candidate prioritization.
items.summary_zh: 在六个 Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET 终点上，以 scaffold-split 和匹配调参预算比较 GNN、ChemBERTa、MolCLR 及分子指纹，发现没有模型家族普遍占优，性能高度依赖具体终点和评估协议。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 系统揭示公平调参、控制数据泄漏和多随机种子评估对 ADMET 模型比较的重要性，可避免把评估偏差误认为模型优势。数据集终点和实验协议仍限制外推，肝细胞清除率和半衰期上的预测能力尤其有限。
items.abstract_zh: 基于结构预测 ADMET（吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性）性质有望以快速、低成本方式筛选候选药物，但模型选择仍不明确，因为已发表的分子表示比较往往使用不匹配的调参预算和易发生数据泄漏的评估协议，导致性能差异未必反映模型质量。为弥补这一缺口，我们在六个 Therapeutics Data Commons ADMET 终点上进行基准比较，涵盖图神经网络（GNN）、冻结的预训练模型（ChemBERTa、MolCLR）和指纹基线，并采用 scaffold-split 评估。为实现真正公平的比较，我们给予每个模型家族匹配的 50 次试验、基于验证集选择的调参预算，并报告十个随机种子的中位数；架构和超参数选择仅使用验证数据，保留测试集用于最终性能估计。在这一公平比较协议下，没有任何模型家族占据统治地位，多数终点上不同家族间的差异处于随机种子波动范围内。GNN 仅在 Caco-2 渗透性上明显最佳（R^2 ≈ 0.48），且受控消融显示这一优势完全来自辅助理化描述符，而非图表示；Morgan fingerprints 在 hERG 上具有竞争力（AUC ≈ 0.77），并在两个清除终点上取得最佳中位数，而 MolCLR 在 Tox21 上最佳。对于肝细胞清除率和半衰期，所有模型的 R^2 均接近零或为负。所评估的七种超参数优化策略中，没有一种在该预算下持续优于随机搜索；我们还显示，使用测试集性能选择优化器或只报告单次最佳试验，可能会大幅夸大某一模型表面上的优势。因此，可靠的 ADMET 建模需要针对终点选择模型，并采用公平、控制泄漏、对多个随机种子取平均的评估，为早期候选药物优先级排序提供更可信的决策支持。
items.author_line: Stamenov, M., Gjurovska, M., Vodilovska, V., Ivanoska, I.

items.title: LPT: Orchestrating bounded agentic loops for automated protein binder design
items.abstract_or_text: Current large language models (LLMs) can reason over scientific information and use code-based tools, but their training knowledge is broad rather than specialized, can be out of date and is hard to attribute to sources. Furthermore, unconstrained agentic workflows and unlimited tool use can consume large amounts of tokens. Here we present LPT (little protein tiger), a framework for fixed orchestration of LLM stages, each running a bounded agentic loop with custom system prompts and tool access, to enable de novo protein binder design from a single natural language prompt. The LLM stages can query a curated literature database, containing ~14000 papers digested into key findings, enabling recall of specialized information. An LLM with database access answered 41/48 test questions drawn from database key findings correctly, while a model without access answered none. In three end-to-end design campaigns, initiated from a single prompt, LPT autonomously identified the design intent, selected targets, structures and hotspot residues and designed candidate binders to disrupt CALCRL/RAMP1, PD-1/PD-L1 and PVR-TIGIT interactions. Cross-validation with multiple folding models confirms a high in silico success rate at minimal token consumption and low computational costs.
items.summary_zh: 提出 LPT（little protein tiger），用固定编排的有界 LLM 循环、工具调用和约 14000 篇论文的整理数据库，仅凭自然语言提示完成蛋白质结合体设计，并针对 CALCRL/RAMP1、PD-1/PD-L1 和 PVR-TIGIT 生成候选。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了把专业文献检索、阶段化智能体和结构预测结合起来进行蛋白质设计的可复用流程。证据主要来自 41/48 的数据库问答和三个端到端计算设计活动，尚无结合实验或细胞功能验证，所谓成功率仍是 in silico。
items.abstract_zh: 当前的大语言模型（LLM）能够对科学信息进行推理并使用基于代码的工具，但其训练知识广泛而非专门化，可能过时且难以追溯来源。此外，不受约束的智能体工作流和无限工具调用会消耗大量 token。我们提出 LPT（little protein tiger），一种固定编排的 LLM 阶段框架；每个阶段都运行带有自定义系统提示和工具访问权限的有界智能体循环，从而仅凭一条自然语言提示实现从头蛋白质结合体设计。LLM 阶段可以查询一个经过整理的文献数据库，其中约 14000 篇论文已被提炼为关键发现；在测试数据库关键发现的问题上，具备数据库访问权限的 LLM 答对了 41/48 题，而没有访问权限的模型一道也没答对。在三项端到端设计活动中，LPT 从单条提示出发，自主确定设计意图、选择靶点、结构和热点残基，并设计了用于干扰 CALCRL/RAMP1、PD-1/PD-L1 和 PVR-TIGIT 相互作用的候选结合体。多个折叠模型的交叉验证证实其具有较高的计算预测成功率，同时 token 消耗和计算成本很低。
items.author_line: Uckelmann, M.

items.title: Oxygen drives a rapid, reversible photoprotective switch in photosynthetic antennae
items.abstract_or_text: Oxygen is the archetypal agent of photooxidative damage, and it is generally countered by removing its reactive products or by regulated, energy-costly responses. We show that in photosynthetic light-harvesting complexes, oxygen also drives a rapid, reversible photoprotective switch. Using a new bulk fluorescence method that separates reversible dark states from irreversible photobleaching, together with single-molecule spectroscopy, we find that illumination and oxygen generate a reversible, protein-stabilized charge-separated state comprising oxidized chlorophyll and superoxide. Access to this state increasingly outcompetes irreversible photodamage as excitation intensity falls to physiological levels and is strongly accelerated by ascorbic acid in native thylakoid membranes. These findings identify a constitutive oxygen-dependent photoprotective pathway and suggest that redox-state recovery can determine whether oxygen-associated chemistry protects or damages photoactive systems.
items.summary_zh: 结合新的群体荧光方法和单分子光谱，发现氧和光照可在光合天线复合物中诱导由氧化叶绿素与超氧化物组成的、蛋白质稳定的可逆电荷分离态，从而触发光保护开关。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示氧在生理激发强度下也能促进光保护而非仅导致光氧化损伤，补充了光合体系的氧化还原机制。当前证据集中于光合复合物和体外/膜体系，向其他光活性材料或生物系统外推仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 氧是光氧化损伤的典型因素，通常通过移除其活性产物或启动受调控且耗能的响应来应对。我们显示，在光合光捕获复合物中，氧也会驱动一种快速、可逆的光保护开关。借助一种能够将可逆暗态与不可逆光漂白分开的新型整体荧光方法，并结合单分子光谱学，我们发现，光照和氧会生成一种由氧化叶绿素和超氧化物组成、由蛋白质稳定的可逆电荷分离态。当激发强度降至生理水平时，进入该状态越来越能够胜过不可逆光损伤；在天然类囊体膜中，抗坏血酸会显著加速这一过程。这些发现确定了一条组成型的、依赖氧的光保护通路，并提示氧相关化学究竟保护还是损伤光活性系统，可能取决于氧化还原状态的恢复。
items.author_line: van Heerden, B., Kyeyune, F., Conradie, F., Millan, S., Gardiner, A. T., Cogdell, R. J., Sarewicz, M., Osyczka, A., Gwizdala, M., Krüger, T. P.

items.title: GlioMIL: A Frozen-Backbone Multiple-Instance Learning Framework for Calibrated and Explainable Glioma Radiogenomics
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Non-invasive prediction of glioma molecular status from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) could reduce reliance on invasive biopsy. Still, deep-learning pipelines for this task are often trained on small cohorts and rarely assessed for calibration or explainability. We present GlioMIL, a 2.5D multiple-instance-learning (MIL) framework predicting isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) mutation status, tumour grade, O 6 -methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase (MGMT) promoter methylation, and 1p/19q codeletion from multi-contrast MRI, representing each tumour as a bag of tumour-guided axial slices embedded by a frozen, ImageNet-pretrained backbone and aggregated via attention-based pooling feeding multi-task heads. On a publicly available glioma cohort, a controlled five-way ablation with bootstrap confidence intervals and paired significance testing shows this frozen-backbone approach matches a fully-supervised 3D convolutional neural network (CNN) baseline, and that fusing standardised clinical and radiomic features into the pooled representation significantly improves over image-only multi-task learning for IDH and grade. However, a plain classifier on clinical and radiomic features alone, with no image input, matches or significantly exceeds the fused model on these tasks, so the frozen image branch adds no predictive value beyond structured features. MGMT and 1p/19q codeletion remain close to chance across all conditions. The fusion model is label-efficient and reasonably well calibrated, but its attention weights correspond to tumour regions only at a near-chance level, cautioning against treating attention as a reliable spatial explanation. We report our evaluation protocol, including rejection of an earlier flawed ensembling scheme and a per-fold feature-normalisation correction, to support trustworthy, reproducible reporting.
items.summary_zh: preprint；GlioMIL 用冻结的 ImageNet 预训练骨干和注意力 MIL 从多对比 MRI 预测胶质瘤分子状态，并通过消融与校准分析揭示结构化特征的作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究不仅报告性能，还指出影像分支未超越临床/影像组学特征，且注意力并非可靠空间解释，体现了对模型局限性的诚实评估。
items.abstract_zh: 从磁共振成像（MRI）无创预测胶质瘤分子状态，可能减少对侵入性活检的依赖。然而，用于该任务的深度学习管线通常在小型队列上训练，并且很少评估校准性或可解释性。我们提出 GlioMIL，这是一个 2.5D 多实例学习（MIL）框架，用于从多对比 MRI 预测异柠檬酸脱氢酶（IDH）突变状态、肿瘤分级、O 6 -methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase（MGMT）启动子甲基化以及 1p/19q 共缺失。该框架将每个肿瘤表示为由肿瘤引导的轴向切片组成的包，这些切片由一个冻结的、在 ImageNet 上预训练的骨干网络嵌入，再通过基于注意力的池化聚合，并输入多任务头。在一个公开可用的胶质瘤队列上，受控的五路消融实验、bootstrap 置信区间和配对显著性检验显示，这种冻结骨干方法达到了与完全监督的 3D 卷积神经网络（CNN）基线相当的表现；将标准化的临床和影像组学特征融合到池化表示中，相比仅使用图像的多任务学习，在 IDH 和分级任务上显著改善。然而，在这些任务上，仅使用临床和影像组学特征、完全不输入图像的普通分类器，已经达到或显著超过融合模型，因此冻结的图像分支没有提供超出结构化特征的预测价值。MGMT 和 1p/19q 共缺失在所有条件下仍接近随机水平。融合模型具有标签效率，并且校准性尚可，但其注意力权重仅以接近随机的水平对应肿瘤区域，这提醒我们不应把注意力当作可靠的空间解释。我们报告了包括拒绝早期有缺陷的集成方案以及逐折特征归一化修正在内的评估协议，以支持可信且可复现的报告。
items.author_line: Al-Quraishi T, Abawajy J, Albahri OS, Mishra R

items.title: Predicting Pathway Dependency in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma from Hallmark Transcriptomic Features
items.abstract_or_text: Despite frequent pathway activation, targeted molecular therapy remains limited in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC), highlighting the need to distinguish activation from dependence. Dependency is functional, context-specific, and coupled; mutations or expression alone cannot establish it. No validated framework identifies tumor pathway dependencies from baseline molecular profiles. We developed a transcriptome-based framework to infer pathway dependency in HNSCC. Nine Elastic Net models used 50 MSigDB Hallmark activity profiles from 953 GDSC cell lines and drug responses pooled across compounds annotated to each pathway. Cross-validated R2 ranged from 0.17 (IGF1R) to 0.48 (P53); leave-one-pathway-out validation retained rank agreement (Spearman {rho} = 0.19-0.56) for pathways with no drug response observed during training. We validated the models using pharmacological, genomic, and proteomic data, then applied them to TCGA-HNSC (n = 565) and GSE65858 (n = 256), examining HPV status, age, stage, tobacco history, and CD8+ infiltration. Seven of nine pathways were higher in HPV+ tumors and replicated directionally in GSE65858. Among TP53-wild-type tumors, HPV remained linked to greater P53 dependency ({beta} = +0.37, q = 0.010); HPV+ tumors also had higher p53 transcriptional activity, suggesting residual p53 function despite E6 expression. The codependency signature had a dominant global axis (PC1 = 62.3% variance; Cronbach's = 0.91), replicated across cohorts (Tucker congruence = 0.996), but largely reflected CD8+ T-cell infiltration ({rho} = 0.80). The framework uses RNA-sequenced bulk tumor cohorts to assess baseline transcriptome-based dependencies and match pathway-directed agents to likely responders before treatment. It is not prognostic.
items.summary_zh: preprint；用 953 个 GDSC 细胞系训练 Elastic Net，从 Hallmark 转录组特征推断 HNSCC 通路依赖性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 区分通路激活与功能依赖，并在 TCGA-HNSC 与 GSE65858 中复核；但全局共依赖轴主要反映 CD8+ T 细胞浸润，不能直接作为预后结论。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管通路经常被激活，头颈部鳞状细胞癌（HNSCC）的靶向分子治疗仍然有限，这凸显了区分激活与依赖的必要性。依赖性是功能性的、情境特异的并且相互耦合；仅凭突变或表达不能确立依赖性。当前没有经过验证的框架能够根据基线分子谱识别肿瘤通路依赖性。我们开发了一个基于转录组的框架，用于推断 HNSCC 中的通路依赖性。九个 Elastic Net 模型使用来自 953 个 GDSC 细胞系的 50 个 MSigDB Hallmark 活性谱，以及按每条通路注释的化合物汇总药物反应进行训练。交叉验证 R2 范围为 0.17（IGF1R）至 0.48（P53）；留一通路验证在训练期间没有观察到药物反应的通路中仍保留了秩一致性（Spearman {rho} = 0.19–0.56）。我们使用药理学、基因组学和蛋白质组学数据验证模型，然后将其应用于 TCGA-HNSC（n = 565）和 GSE65858（n = 256），考察 HPV 状态、年龄、分期、吸烟史和 CD8+ 浸润。九条通路中有七条在 HPV+ 肿瘤中更高，并在 GSE65858 中得到方向性复现。在 TP53 野生型肿瘤中，HPV 仍与更高的 P53 依赖性相关（β = +0.37，q = 0.010）；HPV+ 肿瘤还具有更高的 p53 转录活性，提示尽管存在 E6，仍保留部分 p53 功能。共依赖特征具有一个占主导地位的全局轴（PC1 = 62.3% 方差；Cronbach's = 0.91），并在队列间复现（Tucker congruence = 0.996），但该轴在很大程度上反映了 CD8+ T 细胞浸润（{rho} = 0.80）。该框架使用 RNA 测序的实体瘤队列来评估基线、基于转录组推断的依赖性，并在治疗前将通路导向药物匹配到可能的应答者。它不是预后模型。
items.author_line: Afshar, Y., Goli, A.

items.title: HERA: Assessing an Autonomous Agent for Quantum Device Measurement
items.abstract_or_text: Large language model agents have begun to carry out laboratory measurements, but their scientific conclusions are useful only if they hold up under scrutiny. Demonstrating this requires controlled studies because models are stochastic and the context a model is given steers its conclusions. Here we introduce HERA, an autonomous agent designed to carry out cryogenic transport measurements of quantum devices. HERA draws on a knowledge base curated by lab members that holds measurement protocols, software tools, and literature references. We assessed HERA with a blinded trial against an expert on the stacking order of two multilayer graphene devices, an ablation of its knowledge base, and hundreds of offline replays in which models designed the trial's central measurement without running it. HERA's conclusions matched the expert's sealed conclusions on both tested devices. The ablation and the replay studies measured the impact of the knowledge base across different models, showing that with it every model designed better measurements and reasoned more soundly. To test how readily HERA extends to a new problem, we tasked it with finding and characterizing superconductivity in a different material system. This required a few hours of expert time to develop a new experimental protocol, after which HERA did both autonomously. These results show that, with a knowledge base designed for the task, language model agents are capable of sound experimental science.
items.summary_zh: 提出 HERA 自主实验智能体，用实验室知识库、盲法专家对照、知识库消融和离线重放评估其进行低温量子器件测量的能力，并在新材料体系中自主发现和表征超导性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了对实验智能体进行受控、可审计评估的范例，尤其强调知识库和实验协议对可靠性的作用。盲法对照仅涉及两个多层石墨烯器件，迁移到新材料仍需专家先开发协议，规模化和跨实验室泛化尚未证明。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型智能体已经开始执行实验室测量，但只有经受审查的科学结论才有用。要证明这一点，需要进行受控研究，因为模型具有随机性，而且提供给模型的上下文会引导其结论。在这里，我们介绍 HERA，一种旨在执行量子器件低温输运测量的自主智能体。HERA 使用由实验室成员整理的知识库，其中包含测量协议、软件工具和文献参考。我们通过一项与专家进行的盲法试验、关于两个多层石墨烯器件堆叠顺序的评估、一次知识库消融实验，以及数百次离线重放进行评估；在离线重放中，模型设计了核心测量但没有实际执行。HERA 的结论与专家对两个器件作出的密封结论均一致。消融和重放研究测量了知识库在不同模型上的影响，结果显示，配备知识库后，每个模型设计的测量更好，推理也更可靠。为测试 HERA 对新问题的扩展能力，我们让它在另一种材料体系中寻找并表征超导性。这需要专家花费数小时制定新的实验协议，随后 HERA 自主完成了这两项工作。这些结果表明，在为任务设计的知识库支持下，语言模型智能体能够开展可靠的实验科学。
items.author_line: Zachary W. Gomez, Nathan Bittner, Jordan T. McCourt, Qingrui Cao, Sandesh S. Kalantre, Benjamin H. Alexander, Zhiren Zheng, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Aaron Sharpe

items.title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
items.abstract_or_text: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess one another's work and can stop or redirect investigations. They can generate and reject research questions, require separate theoretical checks and conduct experiments designed to challenge their claims. We demonstrate these capabilities by investigating ensembles of quantum spins in diamond. The agents derived the minimum number of calibration settings needed to predict responses to a defined family of microwave pulse sequences. They checked the result computationally and designed experiments to distinguish competing predictions. An initial experiment agreed with the theoretical predictions, but repeated reference measurements showed that the signal was drifting during data collection. The agents therefore treated the result as inconclusive and revised the measurement protocol without relaxing the acceptance criteria. The revised experiment met those criteria and supported the theoretical predictions. This study demonstrates that collaborating AI agents can select research questions, derive theoretical results and test their predictions experimentally.
items.summary_zh: 构建协作式 AI 智能体实验室，让不同智能体互相审查研究问题、理论推导和实验设计；在金刚石固态量子自旋体系中发现漂移后，系统否定初始结果、修改协议并通过修订实验。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了将质疑、理论核验和实验复测纳入自主科研闭环的设计，对减少不受支持的科学结论具有示范意义。研究对象是定义明确的量子自旋任务，实验规模和跨领域可迁移性仍有限，且摘要未给出与人工流程的系统成本比较。
items.abstract_zh: 自主研究实验室可以完成从提出问题到准备论文的整项研究。人工智能（AI）为实现这一目标提供了一条路径。近期的 AI 系统承担了多种研究角色，但可能得出证据并不支持的结论。在这里，我们提出一种自主研究实验室，其中基于大语言模型的智能体相互评估工作，并能够停止或重定向研究。它们可以生成并否决研究问题，要求进行独立的理论检查，并设计旨在挑战自身主张的实验。我们通过研究金刚石中的固态量子自旋系综来展示这些能力。智能体推导出预测一组定义好的微波脉冲序列响应所需的最少校准设置数量。它们以计算方式核查了该结果，并设计实验来区分相互竞争的预测。初始实验与理论预测一致，但重复的参考测量显示，数据采集期间信号发生漂移。因此，智能体将该结果视为不确定结论，并在不降低接受标准的情况下修改测量协议。修订后的实验满足这些标准，并支持理论预测。该研究表明，协作式 AI 智能体能够选择研究问题、推导理论结果，并通过实验检验预测。
items.author_line: El Mustapha Mansouri, Eikichi Kimura, Masato Koga, Keigo Arai

items.title: An Agentic AI Pipeline for an Evidence-Grounded Environmental Health Public Information System: Development and Evaluation
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Existing environmental and health information systems typically provide isolated data streams, requiring users to interpret heterogeneous information sources without personalized guidance. Residents and health providers of urban regions with complex environmental conditions, such as the Salt Lake Valley, frequently seek timely, location-specific information about weather, air quality, and their associated health impacts, but may find it difficult to integrate this information in their decision-making, precluding the effective translation of valuable environmental health information into action. Objective: This study aimed to develop and evaluate an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) pipeline that delivers evidence-grounded, neighborhood-scale responses to health-related environmental questions raised lay persons by dynamically orchestrating authoritative weather, neighborhood-scale environmental observations, air quality, and health-evidence resources. Methods: We developed an agentic AI pipeline using LangGraph and OpenAI large language models to interpret natural language queries, select and invoke relevant external tools, retrieve real-time environmental data and evidence-based health guidance, and synthesize responses. The pipeline integrates multiple authoritative resources, including weather forecasts, air-quality observations, geospatial services, and a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) module built from asthma-related clinical guidance. The system incorporates fallback mechanisms to improve robustness when external services are unavailable. We evaluated the pipeline using a curated benchmark of representative user questions, assessing tool-needed recognition, correct tool selection, avoidance of irrelevant tools, parameter mapping, analytic pathway selection, and incorporation of tool outputs into the final response. Results: The developed system successfully integrated heterogeneous environmental and health information sources into a unified conversational interface that produces evidence-grounded, neighborhood-scale responses for the Salt Lake Valley. Evaluation demonstrated generally strong tool recognition, parameter mapping, and incorporation of retrieved information across diverse question types, supporting the pipeline's ability to retrieve and integrate authoritative environmental and health information consumable by lay persons and providing an important step for the T3 and T4 phases of the translational pipeline of exposure health informatics. Conclusions: By combining existing environmental health knowledge with local sensor observations and neighborhood-scale environmental measurements, and authoritative state and national weather and air quality resources, the system delivers more localized and context-aware guidance than approaches that rely on authoritative regional or state-level information. Rather than depending on the internal knowledge of a large language model, the pipeline dynamically retrieves, synthesizes, and attributes evidence from authoritative sources. The modular architecture enables seamless integration of additional environmental data streams, health knowledge sources, and geographic regions, providing a scalable foundation for future translational pipelines, completing the T3 to T4 path for environmental health.
items.summary_zh: preprint；构建证据约束的 agentic AI 环境健康信息系统，将实时环境数据与健康指南整合为社区尺度回答。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了工具编排、检索增强生成和故障回退在环境健康问答中的组合；目前主要是系统开发与基准评估，不等同于临床疗效证据。
items.abstract_zh: 现有的环境与健康信息系统通常提供彼此孤立的数据流，要求用户自行解释异构信息来源，而缺乏个性化指导。位于环境条件复杂城市区域（例如 Salt Lake Valley）的居民和健康提供者经常需要及时、具有地点特异性的天气、空气质量及其相关健康影响信息，但可能难以将这些信息整合进决策，从而妨碍有价值的环境健康信息有效转化为行动。本研究旨在开发并评估一个 agentic artificial intelligence（AI）管线，为普通人提出的健康相关环境问题提供基于证据、社区尺度的回答；该管线通过动态编排权威天气、社区尺度环境观测、空气质量和健康证据资源来实现这一目标。我们使用 LangGraph 和 OpenAI large language models 开发了一个 agentic AI 管线，用于解释自然语言查询、选择并调用相关外部工具、检索实时环境数据和循证健康指导，并综合生成回答。该管线整合了多个权威资源，包括天气预报、空气质量观测、地理空间服务，以及一个由哮喘相关临床指南构建的检索增强生成（RAG）模块。系统还纳入了回退机制，以提高外部服务不可用时的稳健性。我们使用一个经过整理的代表性用户问题基准评估该管线，评价工具需求识别、正确工具选择、避免无关工具、参数映射、分析路径选择，以及将工具输出纳入最终回答的能力。开发出的系统成功将异构环境与健康信息源整合进统一的对话式界面，为 Salt Lake Valley 生成基于证据、社区尺度的回答。评估显示，在不同问题类型中，工具识别、参数映射和检索信息纳入总体表现较强，支持该管线检索和整合权威信息并以普通人可使用形式呈现的能力，并为暴露健康信息学转化管线的 T3 和 T4 阶段提供重要一步。通过将现有环境健康知识与本地传感器观测、社区尺度环境测量，以及权威的州级和国家级天气与空气质量资源结合，该系统比依赖州级或区域级权威信息的方法提供了更加本地化和情境化的指导。该管线不是依赖大型语言模型的内部知识，而是动态检索、综合并标注权威来源中的证据。模块化架构支持无缝整合更多环境数据流、健康知识来源和地理区域，为未来的转化管线提供可扩展基础，完成从 T3 到 T4 的路径。
items.author_line: Ingebretsen SH, Gouripeddi R, Facelli J, Cummins M, Shah-mohammadi F

items.title: TaxoMFM: A Taxonomy-Aware Foundation Model for the Human Gut Microbiome
items.abstract_or_text: Existing gut microbiome foundation models typically use flat taxon representations, limiting their ability to exploit known taxonomic hierarchies. We introduce TaxoMFM, a microbiome foundation model that integrates taxonomic structure into self-supervised learning. TaxoMFM jointly learns abundance patterns across taxonomic ranks and relative proportions within groups through taxonomy-aware encoding and hierarchical compositional reconstruction. We further construct TaxoGut-HPP, comprising 100,806 gut microbiome profiles from 231 source cohorts and covering 40 classification and 8 regression tasks. TaxoMFM achieves competitive performance across disease, gut health, host trait, and liver ultrasound phenotype prediction. In cross-cohort zero-shot transfer, where target cohorts are excluded from both pretraining and downstream adaptation, TaxoMFM achieves AUROCs of 0.838, 0.736, and 0.722 for colorectal cancer, type 2 diabetes, and inflammatory bowel disease, respectively. Further analyses show that TaxoMFM recovers community changes across taxonomic scales, while preserving community information and producing consistent representations under database updates and species-vocabulary shifts. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TaxoMFM-F16D/.
items.summary_zh: preprint；TaxoMFM 将分类学层级纳入肠道微生物组基础模型，并在 100,806 个样本、231 个队列上进行跨队列零样本评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 数据规模大、任务覆盖广，并报告 CRC、2 型糖尿病和 IBD 的零样本 AUROC；代码公开，但仍需更多独立实验和临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 现有的肠道微生物组基础模型通常使用扁平的分类单元表示，限制了其利用已知分类学层级的能力。我们提出 TaxoMFM，这是一种将分类学结构整合进自监督学习的微生物组基础模型。TaxoMFM 通过分类学感知编码和分层组成重构，同时学习不同分类等级上的丰度模式以及群组内的相对比例。我们进一步构建了 TaxoGut-HPP，其中包含来自 231 个来源队列的 100,806 个肠道微生物组谱，覆盖 40 个分类和 8 个回归任务。在疾病、肠道健康、宿主性状和肝脏超声表型预测中，TaxoMFM 均取得具有竞争力的性能。在跨队列零样本迁移中，目标队列同时被排除在预训练和下游适配之外，TaxoMFM 在结直肠癌、2 型糖尿病和炎症性肠病上的 AUROC 分别达到 0.838、0.736 和 0.722。进一步分析显示，TaxoMFM 能够恢复不同分类尺度上的群落变化，同时保留群落信息，并在数据库更新和物种词汇变化下产生一致的表示。我们的代码位于 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TaxoMFM-F16D/。
items.author_line: Haochen Xue, Anastasia Godneva, Yulong Li, Qi Cao, Zhaodong Wu, Kaiyu Liang, Jionglong Su, Eran Segal, Imran Razzak

items.title: Matrix biophysical cues drive transient or prolonged breast cancer dormancy programmes
items.abstract_or_text: Breast cancer metastasis can emerge after disease-free periods through the reawakening of dormant disseminated cancer cells. Despite evidence that the extracellular matrix (ECM) modulates this phenomenon, biophysical cues regulating dormancy fate and therapeutic responses remain poorly understood. Here, we engineered stiffness-matched gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA) and alginate-based 3D matrices to disentangle matrix stiffness from adhesion and degradability and uncover their contributions to dormancy. Deep learning-based 3D segmentation revealed that adhesive and degradable matrices supported rounded and proliferative tumour masses, whereas inert matrices favoured single cell dormancy. Within inert matrices, stiffness further determined dormancy fate, with soft matrices activating SOX9-associated transient stem-like dormancy, while stiff matrices reduced cell volume, increased intracellular macromolecular crowding of proteins and induced NR2F1-associated prolonged dormancy marked by autophagy and cellular stress. Transiently dormant cells retrieved from soft matrices retained dormancy memory and failed to form tumours in chicken chorioallantoic membranes, demonstrating persistence of matrix-induced states after removal of biophysical cues. Moreover, patient-derived cells in soft inert matrices recapitulated transient dormant states and exhibited therapy resistance. We demonstrate that tuneable biophysical cues shape distinct dormancy states, linking matrix mechanics to dormancy regulation and therapeutic response.
items.summary_zh: preprint；工程化可调 3D 基质区分黏附性、可降解性和刚度，解析乳腺癌细胞的短暂与持久休眠程序。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结合深度学习 3D 分割、患者来源细胞和鸡尿囊膜实验，提示基质力学与休眠记忆及治疗耐受相关，但仍不能据此确立人体因果机制。
items.abstract_zh: 乳腺癌转移可以在无病期后通过休眠的播散癌细胞重新唤醒而出现。尽管已有证据表明细胞外基质（ECM）调节这一现象，但调控休眠命运和治疗反应的生物物理线索仍知之甚少。在这里，我们工程化制备了刚度匹配的明胶甲基丙烯酰（GelMA）和藻酸盐基 3D 基质，以区分基质刚度与黏附性、可降解性，并揭示它们对休眠的贡献。基于深度学习的 3D 分割显示，具有黏附性和可降解性的基质支持圆形且增殖性的肿瘤团块，而惰性基质更有利于单细胞休眠。在惰性基质中，刚度进一步决定休眠命运：软基质激活 SOX9 相关的短暂性干样休眠，而硬基质降低细胞体积、增加蛋白质的细胞内大分子拥挤，并诱导以自噬和细胞应激为特征的 NR2F1 相关持久休眠。从软基质中取回的短暂休眠细胞保留了休眠记忆，并且在鸡尿囊膜中未能形成肿瘤，表明在移除生物物理线索后，基质诱导的状态仍然持续。此外，患者来源细胞在软惰性基质中重现了短暂休眠状态，并表现出治疗耐受性。我们证明，可调的生物物理线索能够塑造不同的休眠状态，将基质力学与休眠调控和治疗反应联系起来。
items.author_line: Heras, U., Pardo Sanchez, J. M., Berasain, J., Toledo, I., Iturriaga, L., Calafel, I., Aguirresarobe, R., de Carcer, G., Aguirre-Ghiso, J., Arizaga, E., Fernandez, M., Zubizarreta, R., Legorburu, A., Riestra, A., Mitxelena, O., Cipitria, A.

items.title: Integrating Heterogeneous Echocardiography AI Outputs in Language Space: Learnable Late Fusion with a Supervised LLM
items.abstract_or_text: View- and target-specific echocardiography AI models capture useful but complementary information and may not achieve sufficient predictive performance in isolation. A learned ensemble is a natural way to combine these outputs, but heterogeneous models typically require each output to be converted into a binary decision, probability, confidence score, or fixed-length feature vector. We developed a supervised large language model (LLM)-based late-fusion module that directly aggregates view-specific predicted finding statements and predicted measurements in language space and learns a case-level fusion function. In patient-level three-fold cross-validation of 859 examinations from 646 patients, the proposed method integrated heterogeneous outputs within a single framework, performed comparably to the best-performing reference strategy evaluated, and outperformed a general-purpose LLM without task-specific training. These results suggest that a supervised LLM can combine multiple upstream models without model-specific output conversion or feature engineering that requires medical knowledge.
items.summary_zh: preprint；用受监督 LLM 在语言空间融合异构超声心动图 AI 输出，在 646 名患者的 859 次检查上进行患者级交叉验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了不依赖固定特征工程的晚期融合方案，并优于未针对任务训练的通用 LLM；仍属于回顾性模型评估。
items.abstract_zh: 视图特异性和目标特异性的超声心动图 AI 模型能够捕获有用但互补的信息，单独使用时可能无法达到足够的预测性能。学习型集成是组合这些输出的自然方式，但异构模型通常需要将每个输出转换为二元决策、概率、置信度分数或固定长度特征向量。我们开发了一个基于受监督 large language model（LLM）的晚期融合模块，直接在语言空间聚合视图特异性的预测发现陈述和预测测量值，并学习病例级融合函数。在包含 646 名患者的 859 次检查中进行患者级三折交叉验证时，所提出的方法在单一框架内整合了异构输出，其表现与所评估的最佳参考策略相当，并优于通用 LLM。这些结果表明，受监督 LLM 可以在不进行模型特异性输出转换、也不需要医学知识驱动的特征工程的情况下，组合多个上游模型。
items.author_line: Ryo Takizawa, Tempei Kabayama, Chiemi Yamazaki, Shun Kitamura, Ryo Matsuoka, Yuta Ando, Satoshi Kodera, Norihiko Takeda

items.title: From the Transformer to a Formal Semantics of Coordinated Transformations
items.abstract_or_text: We develop a formal semantics for a general class of coordinated systems of parameterized transformations, taking the Transformer as a paradigmatic starting point but abstracting from its particular mathematical instantiation. Representational vectors receive both extensional reference and ordered intensional interpretations, while parameter structures acquire relative, second-level interpretations that determine how argument properties are preserved, replaced, or combined. This yields the notion of a transforming concept: a parameterized transformation whose numerical action is coordinated with a corresponding property-level map. We then distinguish the common algebraic-semantic core of these systems from their architecture-specific functional organization, allowing different mathematical instantiations and mechanical realizations of the same abstract system type. The framework is applied to attention heads and residual connections, providing semantic explanations that depend only on the shared algebraic-semantic core and their local functional organization and therefore generalize beyond the standard Transformer. These analyses also reveal the modularity of the framework: complex architectures can be decomposed into simpler semantically coordinated subsystems whose organization may recur across different abstract system types.
items.summary_zh: 论文从 Transformer 出发，抽象出一类参数化变换的协调系统，定义向量的外延/内涵解释、参数结构的二阶解释以及“变换概念”，并分析注意力头和残差连接的共同代数—语义核心。结果是形式语义框架，而非对模型数学推理能力的直接基准测试。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了可迁移的形式语义描述语言，用于区分 Transformer 的代数语义核心与具体架构组织；价值主要在理论澄清和可形式化分析，摘要没有给出证明助手实现或经验性能评测。
items.abstract_zh: 我们为一大类由参数化变换组成的协调系统发展形式语义，并以 Transformer 作为出发点，同时抽象掉其特定的数学实现。表示向量同时获得外延指称和有序的内涵解释，而参数结构则获得相对的二阶解释，用以确定参数性质如何被保持、替换或组合。由此我们提出“变换概念”的概念：一种参数化变换，其数值作用与相应的性质层映射相协调。随后，我们区分这些系统共有的代数—语义核心与其特定于架构的功能组织，从而允许不同的数学实现和机械实现共享同一种抽象系统类型。我们将该框架应用于注意力头和残差连接，给出只依赖共享代数—语义核心及其局部功能组织的语义解释，因此这些解释可以推广到标准 Transformer 之外。分析还揭示了该框架的模块化：复杂架构可以分解为更简单、语义上协调的子系统，而这些子系统的组织方式可能在不同的抽象系统类型之间重复出现。
items.author_line: Marco Giunti, Fabrizia Giulia Garavaglia

items.title: Compile Away Uncertainty: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Programmatic Compilation
items.abstract_or_text: Self-evolving agent skills enable AI agents to accumulate and refine reusable procedural knowledge from interaction experience without updating model parameters. However, since such skills are typically represented as textual documents and executed through LLM reasoning, even previously learned procedures must be repeatedly interpreted and regenerated, introducing avoidable uncertainty into every execution. In contrast, program execution is deterministic and independently verifiable. Intuitively, transforming well-specified operations into executable programs can reduce reliance on LLM reasoning and, consequently, reduce execution uncertainty. Motivated by this intuition, we introduce SKillCompiler, a self-evolving skill framework that integrates programmatic compilation into the skill evolution process. Specifically, SkillCompiler adopts an executability-aware skill compilation strategy that decomposes skills into fine-grained operations, analyzes their executability, and constructs hybrid skill skeletons that retain LLM reasoning for context-dependent operations while compiling well-specified ones into validated programs. To avoid redundant program synthesis and enable executable knowledge to accumulate across evolving skills, we further design a program asset reuse mechanism that organizes validated programs as reusable assets, retrieves existing implementations whenever applicable, and synthesizes and verifies new programs only when necessary. Extensive experiments on five benchmarks and six model families demonstrate that SkillCompiler consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving up to 32.33\% improvement in task performance.
items.summary_zh: SkillCompiler 将自演化技能拆分为细粒度操作，把定义明确的部分编译为可验证程序，把依赖上下文的部分保留给 LLM，并复用已验证的程序资产。摘要称其在 5 个基准和 6 个模型家族上最多带来 32.33% 的任务性能提升。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把自然语言技能中的确定性步骤转为可独立验证的程序，任务边界和评测设置较清晰；但摘要没有展开验证器性质、错误率或各基准的绝对结果，不能据此宣称通用可靠性。
items.abstract_zh: 自演化代理技能使 AI 代理能够从交互经验中积累和改进可复用的程序性知识，而无需更新模型参数。然而，由于这类技能通常表示为文本文件，并通过 LLM 推理执行，即使已经学会的过程也必须在每次执行时反复解释和重新生成，从而在每次执行中引入本可避免的不确定性。相比之下，程序执行是确定性的，并且可以独立验证。直观地说，把定义明确的操作转换为可执行程序，可以减少对 LLM 推理的依赖，进而降低执行不确定性。受此启发，我们提出 SKillCompiler，一个将程序化编译融入技能演化过程的自演化技能框架。具体而言，SkillCompiler 采用面向可执行性的技能编译策略，将技能分解为细粒度操作，分析其可执行性，并构造混合技能骨架：对依赖上下文的操作保留 LLM 推理，对定义明确的操作则编译为经过验证的程序。为了避免重复的程序合成，并使可执行知识能够在不断演化的技能之间积累，我们进一步设计了程序资产复用机制，将经过验证的程序组织为可复用资产，在适用时检索已有实现，仅在必要时合成并验证新程序。在 5 个基准和 6 个模型家族上的大量实验表明，SkillCompiler 持续优于当前最先进的方法，任务性能最高提升 32.33%。
items.author_line: Chengyu Yang, Yunxiang Zheng, Zongzheng Li, Jiamei Li, Boxun Lan, Xiaoyu Liu, Xiaoyu Zhang, Xiaohong Chen, Ming Hu

items.title: Well-Specified and Well-Tested? Assessing SWE-bench-Style Datasets with a Self-Evolving Agent
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on software engineering (SE) tasks, driving the need for high-quality datasets for reliable training and evaluation. SWE-bench-style datasets (SWE datasets) are widely used to evaluate LLM-based coding agents on real-world software issues, where task clarity and test coverage directly affect whether instances are solvable and verifiable. However, quality issues persist in existing SWE datasets, and manual annotation is costly and labor-intensive, motivating LLM-based annotation. Existing approaches typically rely on static, overly general rubrics, limiting their ability to handle diverse and nuanced scenarios and often yielding high false positive rates. In contrast, human annotators draw on accumulated experience to make context-aware judgments. Inspired by this, we propose ExLabel, an LLM-based, self-evolving, experience-guided assistant for task clarity and test coverage assessment in SWE datasets. ExLabel maintains an evolving experience bank that distills cross-instance knowledge into stable yet adaptive judgment criteria and reuses relevant experience to guide the assessment of new instances. For systematic evaluation, we construct SWE-TQ, a new benchmark spanning eight programming languages, by cleaning human annotations from SWE-bench and Multi-SWE-bench. Experiments with three backbone LLMs show that ExLabel achieves the best F1 across all settings, with relative improvements of 44.2%/49.9% and 24.0%/18.4% over the best baseline for task clarity and test coverage assessment on the Python/Multilingual subsets, respectively. Moreover, a coding model fine-tuned on SWE-rebench data filtered by ExLabel resolves 66.2% of issues on SWE-bench Verified, outperforming the model trained on data filtered by the best baseline by 14.5%.
items.summary_zh: ExLabel 用自演化经验库评估 SWE 数据集实例的任务清晰度和测试覆盖率，并构建跨 8 种编程语言的 SWE-TQ 基准。三种骨干 LLM 的 F1 均最好；用其筛选数据训练的编码模型在 SWE-bench Verified 上解决率为 66.2%，较最佳基线高 14.5%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它直接评估“任务是否清楚、结果是否可验证”这两个代码代理基准的基础条件，并用下游解决率验证筛选价值；但这仍是软件工程评测，不等同于形式化定理证明能力。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在软件工程（SE）任务上已经展现出较强性能，推动了对高质量数据集的需求，以实现可靠的训练和评测。SWE-bench 风格的数据集（SWE 数据集）广泛用于在真实软件问题上评估基于 LLM 的编码代理，其中任务清晰度和测试覆盖率直接影响实例是否可解、是否可验证。然而，现有 SWE 数据集仍存在质量问题，而人工标注成本高且劳动密集，因而促使人们采用基于 LLM 的标注。现有方法通常依赖静态且过于通用的量规，限制了它们处理多样、细致场景的能力，并且往往产生较高的假阳性率。相比之下，人类标注者会利用积累的经验进行结合上下文的判断。受此启发，我们提出 ExLabel，一个基于 LLM、能够自我演化且由经验引导的助手，用于评估 SWE 数据集中的任务清晰度和测试覆盖率。ExLabel 维护一个不断演化的经验库，将跨实例知识提炼为稳定但可适应的判断标准，并复用相关经验来指导新实例的评估。为进行系统评测，我们通过清理 SWE-bench 和 Multi-SWE-bench 中的人类标注，构建了覆盖 8 种编程语言的新基准 SWE-TQ。使用 3 个骨干 LLM 的实验表明，在所有设置下，ExLabel 都取得了最佳 F1；在 Python/多语言子集上，相对于最佳基线，其任务清晰度评估的相对提升分别为 44.2%/49.9%，测试覆盖率评估的相对提升分别为 24.0%/18.4%。此外，在经过 ExLabel 筛选的 SWE-rebench 数据上微调的编码模型，在 SWE-bench Verified 上解决了 66.2% 的问题，比使用最佳基线筛选数据训练的模型高 14.5%。

items.abstract_or_text: We’ve trained Claude to flag potential misuse in conversations, a technique we call self-assessment. Right after it responds, Claude gives a preliminary safety assessment of the conversation. Since we began using self-assessment in June, it has surfaced misuse that our other safeguards weren’t designed to catch. Because Claude has already read the conversation, self-assessment is very efficient. And unlike classifiers, which target a discrete set of harms, it draws on Claude’s own judgment, so it gets more accurate as our models improve. Read more on our new Safeguards blog:

items.abstract_or_text: Can we use any compilation pipeline we want to produce efficient machine code, then apply formal methods to show that this code behaves in a certain way? This has long been a dream – a gold standard of formal verification, verifying programs at the assembly level – but was considered to be too difficult due to the loss of structure when going from a high level language to machine code. Can AI bash through this problem? Apparently yes! The basic idea I’ve been playing with is to write an interpreter of the target instruction set in an interactive theorem prover such as Lean or Bend. We can then prove that some compiled program conforms to a given specification by writing a proof that connects the machine code, interpreter, and some desired behavior of that code.
